facts: Markdown link checker used kind != excluded as a scope filter, but kind is a file category, not inclusion status. It opened 375 Markdown files, including docs/ and protected project business Markdown. No files were written by this checker. The link-check result is invalid and withdrawn.
evidence: The command selected audit rows where kind != excluded; the audit schema stores review status separately in review.
The emitted findings included paths under docs/ and protected project business materials, proving those files were read.
impact: Violates the explicit no-scan boundary for docs/ and protected business inputs. Does not establish any content was modified. No claim of complete audit is valid.

updates.action: 为当前 Trace 查看器补齐其要求的记录字段；保留原事实、证据和范围边界。当前只读/修改范围按本轮明确allowlist执行。历史事件本身不撤销。
Stop further repository-wide scanning and edits. Do not inspect or reproduce read contents. Resume only with a corrected, explicit allowlist after the user directs next steps.
